children: William O'Dowd IV, the CEO of Dolphin Entertainment, Inc., reported beneficial ownership of 19.0% of the company's common stock. He filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 08, 2026, after an earlier note exchange and a pre-set buying plan in 2025. The position includes common shares and the right to convert company notes into stock at $1.00 per share.

O'Dowd and Dolphin Entertainment LLC exchanged $2,242,873 of old promissory notes for new convertible notes on May 12, 2025, extending maturities and keeping the 10% interest rate. The filing states, "DE LLC may convert the principal balance of the New Notes and any accrued interest thereon at any time before the maturity date of the Note into Common Stock" at a fixed "$1.00 per share" conversion price.

He also adopted a Rule 10b5-1 plan on December 26, 2024 to buy $5,000 of stock per week from April 1 to November 15, 2025, with "no limit price." Separately, a prior agreement restricts conversion and transfer of 50,000 shares of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock unless approved by a majority of independent directors, keeping those potential common shares off the table for now.

William O'Dowd IV is an American media executive and the Chief Executive Officer and a director of Dolphin Entertainment, Inc. He invests through Dolphin Entertainment LLC, a Florida investment entity he solely owns and manages. O'Dowd focuses on long-term ownership in his company and has used structured plans and convertible securities to increase his stake over time.
